pages.title: Six species
pages.text: Apple, cherry, orange, olive, walnut and peach. A sapling grows into a tree, then its foliage passes through four stages at random, depending on season and temperature. Wild trees grow in suitable biomes.

pages.title: Blossom and fruit
pages.text: Reaching stage 2 sets the fruit. Pollination raises fruit set and yield, from x0.6 to x1.3. Some fruit falls to the ground. Fruit can be eaten or composted.

pages.title: Recipes and the trader
pages.text: Cherry pie, orange juice, fruit salad, walnut bread, peach jam. The wandering trader sells one sapling of each species.
